content.text: You keep a wiki of skill-selection failures. Read the staged traces. Each trace has the task text, the offered index, the loads, and the ground-truth skill. Write pattern pages named selection-<what happened>, for example selection-missed-heat-when-microwave-mentioned. finish with the four paper fields create_patterns, update_patterns, update_index, append_log. update_index must mention every pattern stem. Do not edit selection-impact, bodies, descriptions, or catalog.

## iteration 1 reject
- look_at_obj_in_light: Use when the task says to look at, examine, or inspect an object under a desklamp or floorlamp (e.g. "look at the alarmclock under the desklamp"). Not for moving objects.
- pick_and_place: Use for a plain move of ONE object to a destination (e.g. "put a mug on the desk", "move keys to the safe") with no clean/wet, heat/hot, cool/cold word and no count of two. Default for simple moves.
- pick_clean_then_place: Use when the task says to clean (clean, cleaned, wash, wet) an object and then put it somewhere, e.g. "put a clean plate in the cabinet". Uses a sinkbasin. One object.
- pick_cool_then_place: Use when the task says to cool, chill, cold, or refrigerate an object then place it, e.g. "put a cold apple on the table". Uses the fridge. One object.
- pick_heat_then_place: Use when the task says to heat, warm, hot, or cook an object then place it, e.g. "put a hot potato on the countertop". Uses the microwave. One object.
- pick_two_obj_and_place: Use when the task says "two" or gives a count of objects to put somewhere, e.g. "put two pillows on the sofa". Choose this over pick_and_place whenever two items are required.

Evidence: all 8 traces (t1-t8) have no loads and no relevant skill loaded. These include plain puts (credit card, keys, throw pillow), 'two' tasks (alarm clocks, newspapers, salt shakers, pencils) and 'examine the statue with the lamp'. val_f1 was 0.000 for the baseline and for iterations 1-4, and every per-skill recall was 0.

Interpretation: rewriting the descriptions (keywords, examples, 'Use when...') did not change the outcome. The failure is probably that the agent never loads any skill, not that it picks the wrong one. Wording is probably not the cause. Check the load mechanism before making more description edits.

Note: t4 'examine the statue with the lamp' has ground truth pick_and_place, not look_at_obj_in_light. The label and the lamp wording disagree.
